name: Upholstered headboard: KLEPPSTAD with VIHALS nightstands, dresser on the window end, BESTÅ column by the closet
notes:
Alternative, re-checked 2026-10-23: the upholstered-headboard look, KLEPPSTAD with VIHALS nightstands, plus the BESTÅ column by the closet (F-63). The floor lamp and hamper moved up the left wall, from 1" to 15" clear of the door's swing. 14 placed, 10 extras.
bed-1 KLEPPSTAD queen, white frame and Vissle beige headboard (washable cover) (floor): right wall, headboard centered, rot 90, x 95.1-177, y 34.75-97. F-34: 28.75" on the window side to the heater's face, 36" on the bathroom side, the edge of the bathroom door's 36" landing (F-31); F-33: bedding 28.75" from the heater face.
nightstand-1 VIHALS white (floor): window side of the head, x 162.375-177, y 20.125-34.75. F-33: 14.125" from the heater face. The same white VIHALS line as the dining set. shelf-1 LACK wall shelf, white, 11 3/4x10 1/4" (top): the bathroom side's nightstand, hung at mattress height, x 166.75-177, y 97-108.75, so the floor in front of the bathroom door (eyeballed at x 139-169) stays clear for the full 36" (F-31, assumed-position:door). 6.5 lb max and anchored (IKEA): the lamp, a phone and a book.
lamp-1, lamp-2 STORSEGEL (top): on the nightstand and the shelf. art-1 PJÄTTERYD endless tide (top): over the 33.9" textile headboard, centered.
rug-1 TIOKRONA (rug): rot 0, x 44-162, y 18.875-112.875: under the lower 67" of the bed and the bench, stopping short of the nightstand; 12.875" off the heater face (F-33).
dresser-1 STORKLINTA 6-drawer (floor): left wall's window end, x 0-18.9, y 12-67.1. F-33: 6" from the heater face (heater-depth-assumed); F-32: 63.25" from its drawer fronts to the bench; anchor-required (F-21). plant-1 FEJKA (top): on its window end.
bench-1 PERJOHAN pine (floor): across the foot of the bed, 2" off it, x 82.1-93.1, y 46.2-85.6. F-30: 63.25" to the dresser, 30.9" to the BESTÅ column.
floor-lamp-1 TÅGARP (floor): left wall, x 0-9, y 69-78, beside the dresser's lower end. hamper-1 PURRPINGLA (floor): left wall, x 0-17.3, y 80-88. F-31: 15" clear of the door's swing (assumed-position:door).
storage-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, white/Lappviken, 23 5/8x16 1/2x76" (floor, new for F-63): bottom wall at the closet end of the 70" clear run, rot 180, x 70-93.6, y 116.5-133: linens and towels beside the closet, 4' from the bathroom door. F-31: 3" to the side of the closet's 36" landing (x 25-67), assumed-position:closet; anchor-required (F-21: 76"; IKEA: must be securely anchored, never hung). It is the only floor piece that wall can take: the other 46" of the run is the 36" bathroom walkway beside the bed, where this 16.5" depth would leave 19.5" and even a 7 7/8"-deep BESTÅ frame 28.1" (walkway-narrow, F-30; F-34 tight). F-30: 30.9" between it and the bench, then 36" beside the bed to the bathroom.
mirror-1 NISSEDAL 25 5/8x59" (top, moved from the extras onto the plan): hung vertically on the walkway stretch of the 70" wall, rot 180, x 103.8-129.4, flat to the wall, so the 36" walkway stays clear: the full-length mirror between the closet and the bathroom.
Walkways (F-30): door to bathroom along the bottom of the room, 30.9" past the column and 36" beside the bed; the 36" landings in front of the closet and the bathroom door stay clear (F-31, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:door).
Window wall: nothing but the curtains. F-33 allows furniture 6" off the heater, but a cabinet there would box in the heater along the whole hatched wall (heater-depth-assumed), so no BESTÅ goes on it.
Extras: VALEVÅG mattress x1, DVALA queen sheet set x1, SMÅSPORRE Full/Queen insert x1, ÄNGSLILJA natural cover set x1, VILDKORN pillows x2, FJÄDRAR inner cushions x2 in VALLKRASSING gray-green covers x2, VALLKRASSING throw x1, BENGTA block-out panels x2 on the HUGAD rod x1 (about 107", centered on the window; cut the drop to end above the heater, F-33; assumed-position:window).
Not placed: the STORKLINTA and HEMNES 2-drawer nightstands ikea-90559296 and ikea-80242627 (18 7/8" and 15" deep, they stood in front of the bathroom doorway; design review 2026-10-23), a second VIHALS nightstand (any floor nightstand on the bathroom side stands in the bathroom door's 36" landing, F-31) and the BRIMNES wardrobe ikea-90574800. Same headboard reasoning as a.
Total $1,918.78: placed $1,259.88 + extras $658.90; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed, anchor-required (dresser-1, storage-1).
Design review 2026-10-23: the deeper nightstands covered the right 7 to 10.9" of the bathroom doorway with 14 to 15.4" in front, and the slim VIHALS pair that replaced them still covered its last 6.6" at 20.75" out. With F-31's 36" landing in front of every door, the bathroom side takes the LACK floating shelf and the bed group moves up 5/8", so the bed's side is 36" from the bottom wall.
2026-10-25: the heater is 3" deep (Andrew), not the 6" drawn when this layout was made, so every clearance to its face above is 3" more and heater-depth-assumed no longer applies; the bathroom door's landing is now 30" (Andrew: "ok"), and this layout keeps 36" clear in front of it. The NISSEDAL mirror is glass with no safety film on its page (F-21: no glass): a and h leave it out; here, hang one with a safety film, or leave it out.
